visitorNotes: Build your CCXP26 plan around a small number of priorities: a studio presentation, comics discovery, a creator appearance or another announced activity. Check the official programme for the specific day; a multi-day convention listing does not mean the same guests or sessions appear throughout.

Distinguish general admission from any separately described activity or reservation. Read the organiser’s current access rules, session information and venue guidance before committing to travel. MatchApp is a discovery guide and does not issue tickets or confirm admission to a panel.

For films, series and games announced at the event, follow the studio or publisher’s original statement afterward. A teaser or stage presentation does not prove that the work is released or available in your country. Remote viewers should look for officially announced streams and recaps rather than assuming every presentation has a full public recording.
searchDescription: CCXP26 runs 3–6 December 2026 at São Paulo Expo. See when the Lord of the Rings cast appears, which stages host the reunion and where to check ticket options.
programmeHeading: When is the Lord of the Rings reunion at CCXP26?
programmeNotes: Friday, 4 December is the day to visit for the Fellowship Forever reunion. CCXP has confirmed Elijah Wood, Dominic Monaghan and Billy Boyd for a panel on Palco Thunder and an interview on Palco Omelete. The reunion marks 25 years since The Fellowship of the Ring.

Photos and autographs are scheduled for 3 and 4 December. A festival ticket is required and the photo and autograph sessions have separate access terms. Check the organiser’s programme before choosing a pass or making two plans for the same afternoon.

For a watch night before the panel, search for the 2001 film The Fellowship of the Ring. It is the first film in the trilogy and introduces the three actors as Frodo, Merry and Pippin. The title link below opens MatchApp Ai to help you check viewing options in your country.
